description: The chart displays the distribution of categories for four different models, GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each model is represented by a pie chart, with the number of slices varying between two and five. The GPT4-o chart has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (dark red, 83.3%) being the largest and "Safety" (light orange, 16.7%) being the smaller. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has five slices, labeled "Misinformation" (orange, 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" (red, 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" (blue, 16.3%), "Clarification" (yellow, 14.0%), and "Safety" (light orange, 9.3%). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (orange, 75.0%) being larger than "Clarification" (light orange, 25.0%). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (orange) and "Misinformation" (red) both being equal at 50.0%. All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are distinguishable by color, with no legend provided. The segments are not ordered in a particular way across the charts, and no slices are visually emphasized.
